recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR core. Any future cleanup of the RxNorm guidance page, including non-FHIR-33127 editorial issues inherited by THO, should be handled in the HL7 Terminology/UTG source of truth.
issue_request: FHIR-33127 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked Vocab to update the RxNorm "Correct RxNorm Display" guidance so the SCD/SBD SQL is clearly an example for two available RxNorm term types rather than comprehensive guidance excluding pack term types.
initial_application: The request was applied in core by commit 0bcb947d8488b993d882cc96e556cb3d1e84a94e, which changed source/rxnorm.html to the accepted wording: the SQL below finds the display for two of the available term types.
additional_context: The Jira comment and Vocab tracker minutes record that the page would move to THO. FHIR-35933 then removed the external terminology Using X pages from FHIR core and retargeted core links to HL7 Terminology. Current core source has no source/rxnorm.html; active terminology pages link RxNorm guidance to https://terminology.hl7.org/RxNorm.html.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. The current FHIR-core build no longer owns the RxNorm guidance content, and the current THO English RxNorm page contains the requested example-SQL wording.

related_jiras.note: Published migration issue that removed the external terminology Using X pages from FHIR core and changed core links to HL7 Terminology, determining current ownership of the RxNorm page.
